notes.title: Version 1.02... + Soundtrack Released!
notes.notes:
The soundtrack is now out!! Exciting!!
We are also working with Fourth Strike Records to release a limited run of physical cassette tapes of the soundtrack, which we are super excited about!! You can pre-order a copy now at the soundtrack bandcamp page - https://resni.bandcamp.com/album/sparkles-gems-soundtrack

Also there's a few fixes to the game itself:

Changelog:

- "Softie Meow" changed to "Softie" on win screen & text colour fixed
- Fixed panning issue in Sandway's theme music
- Toy bus is visible inside room after you've collected it
- one of the songs is EQ'd

notes.title: Music Stuff - Version 1.01b
notes.notes:
Small update where a couple music tracks were fleshed out more. These were the only things that felt unfinished to me in the soundtrack, now we'll work on making an OST album available for download too some time!

Changelog:
New section at the end of Sandway's theme
A few seconds of guitar solo added to Softie's theme

notes.title: First patch - Version 1.01
notes.notes:
Changelog:

 Helped prevent slowdown on older computers in a couple later story mode cutscenes
 Character names/colours changed in various spots in story mode and win screens
 Other minor cutscene changes
 "Squeeze-through" sound won't get cut off
 A different song choice for one of the story battles
 Credits updated
